module: present_windows — MINIMAL complete disk provisioning (init + partition + format), trust-config
status: P0 rev3 2026-07-27 (folded Codex P2 r2 — NTFS-only, drop fstype knob for is_ours consistency); awaiting Codex P2 r3
directorDecision: Director 2026-07-27: 'not our job to handhold the CI/CD developers; configuration control is their responsibility; if they want to fk up their system we shouldn't stop them.' RIP OUT the WDM-02a fail-closed safety classifier (PRISTINE/OURS/FOREIGN/UNKNOWN, fs-allowlist, RAW-contradiction — over-engineered). Keep ONLY idempotency (force:false + skip-a-disk-that-is-already-ours). Trust the declared unique_id; a mis-declared populated disk gets provisioned (operator's config-control failure), NOT refused. This SUPERSEDES the 02a classifier AND the planned 02c/02d decomposition — the disk-provisioning pipeline collapses into one coherent minimal piece now that the classifier complexity is gone.
goal: Rewrite present_windows.yml's disk logic to the minimal complete pipeline: resolve each declared disk, bring it online+writable, and — UNLESS it is already 'ours' (an NTFS volume labelled our label, case-insensitive; skipped purely for idempotency/no-reformat) — win_initialize_disk (GPT) -> win_partition (100%, drive_letter) -> win_format (NTFS, label, allocation_unit), all force:false. Remove the fail-closed classifier and the terminal deferred-fail; the role now actually provisions.
why: Director rip-out decision. The elaborate 02a classifier was handholding; the minimal role trusts config and is idempotent (a completed run leaves the disk ours -> skipped on re-run; a half-provisioned disk is NOT ours -> re-runs and self-heals, which is strictly better than the classifier refusing it). Mirrors the windows-wsus C02c/d/e modules + gate (skip 'ours') without the multi-state classification.

contract.inputs: platform (vmware|aws) + disks:[] each {unique_id (literal; function/AWS deferred -> fail), drive_letter, label, allocation_unit(default 4096)}. NTFS-ONLY (Codex P2 r2): the role formats NTFS and is_ours recognizes NTFS; the `fstype` field is NOT a knob (reserved/ignored — a future piece can add ReFS by teaching BOTH win_format AND is_ours the configured fs together). This keeps the completed-run skip invariant consistent (formatted-fs always == is_ours-recognized-fs).
contract.idempotency-skip: A disk is 'ours' iff its matched physical disk has a VOLUME — traversed as FLATTENED matched_disk.partitions[].volumes[] (LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-07-27: win_disk_facts physical disks have NO top-level `volumes` key; volumes live under each partition) — whose file_system is NTFS (the role is NTFS-only) AND whose label == the entry's label CASE-INSENSITIVELY. is_ours => SKIP init/partition/format (already provisioned; win_format label-mismatch reformat can't be made param-safe, so an adopted disk is never re-touched). NOT ours => attempt provisioning. No PRISTINE/FOREIGN/UNKNOWN states, no fs-allowlist, no refusal — is_ours is the SOLE state check, for idempotency only. (The merged WDM-02a classifier read top-level .volumes and is superseded by this corrected traversal.)
contract.no-safety-refusal: The role does NOT refuse a disk carrying foreign data — it provisions what is declared. Config control (the correct unique_id) is the operator's responsibility.
contract.normalization: Per-disk inputs normalized IN present_windows.yml at consumption (no validate.yml/defaults logic change): allocation_unit => `disk.allocation_unit | default(4096)`; drive_letter => canonicalized to its UPPERCASE first character (disk.drive_letter | regex_search('^[A-Za-z]') | upper) for win_partition/win_format. win_format.file_system is NTFS (hardcoded, NTFS-only role) — NO fstype knob, so a disk can never be formatted a fs that is_ours won't recognize (Codex P2 r2).
contract.provision-scope: force:false provisions CLEANLY for greenfield + interrupted-greenfield: a blank RAW disk, an initialized-GPT disk with no data partition, or an expected unformatted partition (the proven idempotent cases). It does NOT convert an ARBITRARY foreign/populated layout into the declared single-partition layout — win_initialize_disk(force:false) does not clear an initialized populated disk and win_partition(state=present) is not a general layout-replace. A not-ours POPULATED foreign disk is ATTEMPTED (init/partition/format run, force:false) and gets whatever the modules do (possibly a task failure) — the role neither REFUSES it nor force-wipes it (no force:true, which would break idempotency). If they declare a foreign disk, that is their config-control problem; we don't handhold, but force:false is not a guaranteed wipe (Codex P2 r1 #5).

smallestStep: Rewrite the disk region of present_windows.yml: keep the vendor assert + the literal-unique_id (function-deferred) assert; keep win_disk_facts + the exactly-one-attached resolution (needed for disk_number) + the online/writable fixup; REPLACE the classifier + safety assert + terminal deferred-fail with: per-disk is_ours check, then win_initialize_disk/win_partition/win_format each gated `when: not is_ours`. force:false throughout.
research: windows-wsus wsus/present_windows.yml C02c/d/e (lines 205-257): win_initialize_disk(uniqueid,style=gpt,online=true,force=false) -> win_partition(disk_number=(matches|first).number,partition_size=-1,drive_letter,gpt_type=basic_data,state=present) -> win_format(drive_letter,file_system=ntfs,new_label,allocation_unit_size,full=false,force=false), each gated to SKIP 'ours'. This is the proven idiom; the minimal role uses the same modules + a simple is_ours gate.

win_format force:false is idempotent on a pristine RAW volume (first run formats; re-run size!=0 + label preserved + ALU match -> no-op) BUT reformats on LABEL MISMATCH — which is why we skip-if-ours (idempotency) rather than relying on force:false alone. full:false = quick format (thin VMware disks). allocation_unit_size in BYTES.
win_partition needs disk_number (from the matched disk) — hence keep the attach resolution; win_initialize_disk uses uniqueid (no number).
invariants: force:false on win_initialize_disk AND win_format (idempotent; no forced wipe/reformat; a populated foreign disk is NOT force-wiped).

is_ours = flattened matched_disk.partitions[].volumes[] with file_system NTFS + case-insensitive matching label (LIVE-VERIFIED traversal). SKIP for idempotency. The SOLE state check. No foreign/unknown refusal, no fs-allowlist, no classifier, no terminal deferred-fail.

Per-disk normalization at consumption: allocation_unit|default(4096); drive_letter canonicalized to uppercase first char. win_format.file_system=NTFS hardcoded (NTFS-only role, no fstype knob) so formatted-fs always matches is_ours (Codex P2 r2).
init -> partition -> format per disk, all gated `when: not is_ours`; online-before-is_ours (offline disk enumerates no volumes).
empty disks list => vendor assert only, green; literal-unique_id/function-deferred assert kept (AWS resolve not implemented).
win_shell (online fixup) passes check-winshell-splitargs; ids via environment. tasks/main.yml (loader) untouched; validate.yml guards + defaults values unchanged (doc-only).

scopeLock.scopeNote: defaults/validate/README doc-only: remove references to the ripped-out classifier states / the WDM-02b-deferral / the elaborate safety model; document the trust-config + skip-if-ours idempotency model. No logic change to validate.yml guards or defaults values.
scopeLock.forbidden: tasks/main.yml (loader), any other role, .gitignore, consumer playbooks, .framework-pin

proofs: POSITIVE E2E (live pdq-dev, revert-first, 3 blank disks): the 3 real disks -> not-ours -> init GPT + partition + format; recap changed>0 failed=0 (pipeline GREENS, no deferred-fail). Verify via win_disk_facts: E:=PDQDEPLOY, F:=PDQINVENTORY, G:=PDQSHARE, all NTFS.

IDEMPOTENCY (live, SKIP_REVERT re-run): all 3 now ours (partitions[].volumes NTFS+label) -> skipped -> changed=0 failed=0. THIS is the proof the corrected is_ours traversal works (with the old top-level traversal it would re-format, changed>0).

INTERMEDIATE-STATE self-heal (fixture/reasoned, Codex P2 r1 #6 — a live destructive interruption is unnecessary): reasoned is_ours=false + provisioning-attempted for (a) RAW disk, (b) initialized-GPT no-partition, (c) expected unformatted partition; each is not-ours so the pipeline re-runs and converges.

TRUST-CONFIG / NO-REFUSAL (fixture, non-destructive, Codex P2 r1 #8): an OS-disk-shaped fact with a non-PDQ NTFS volume -> is_ours=false -> the role WOULD provision it (no refusal gate exists). NOT run live (would wipe the OS).
EMPTY greens: disks:[] -> vendor only, green.
judgementCalls: Rip out the classifier per the Director decision; keep only is_ours skip (idempotency) + force:false.

Collapse 02b/02c/02d into this one minimal piece — the decomposition was driven by classifier complexity that no longer exists; a completed init+partition+format run is idempotent (ours on re-run), so no transient-state problem.
Do NOT re-add foreign/unknown refusal at P2 — the Director has decided config control is the operator's job (a P2 recommendation to re-add safety is re-litigating a settled decision).
is_ours by NTFS + case-insensitive label (the durable recognizer, windows-wsus C14e) — this is idempotency, not handholding.
The TRUST-CONFIG proof is a reasoned/fixture check, not a live OS-disk wipe (proving no-refusal without destroying the dev VM).
blastRadius: Higher than 02a — this ACTUALLY formats disks (win_format). Bounded to the 3 declared blank data disks on pdq-dev (revert-first). The trust-config change means a mis-declared populated disk WOULD be wiped — that is the accepted, Director-decided behavior (operator config control).
risk: Provisioning risk is real (formats declared disks) but that IS the role's job; force:false + skip-ours give idempotency. The removed safety is a deliberate Director decision, not an oversight. Dev proof is revert-first on blank disks; no production consumer until the pdq repoint (post-merge).
